package demo;
public class Nest extends BWebServlet {
  public void doPost(WebOp op) {
    Runnable r = new Runnable() {
      public void run() {
        post(a, b, cx);
      }
    };
  }
  public void doPut(WebOp op) {
    cx.getUser().checkInvoke(this, a);
    Runnable r = new Runnable() {
      public void run() {
        post(a, b, cx);
      }
    };
  }
  public void doGet(WebOp op) {
    Runnable r = new Runnable() {
      public void run() {
        post(a, b, cx);
      }
    };
    cx.getUser().checkInvoke(this, a);
  }
  public void doDelete(WebOp op) {
    new BWebServlet() {
      public void doPost(WebOp o) {
        post(a, b, cx);
      }
    };
  }
}
